title: Split the party
summary: The DM can split the party into groups at different places, and merge them back when they meet again.
items: Party → Split the party names up to six groups, each with a letter and colour, chooses where each group is and who goes with it, then shows a receipt.
Everyone stays in the party: balances, the treasure pool, fairness and coin splits are shared as before.
Shops, services, nearby NPCs and property for sale follow each character's own group.
The Groups panel moves a group at once, edits groups, hides a group's place from other players, and merges groups at the same place.
Players see which group they're with and where the others are, and can ask the DM to move their group; the request waits in Review Inbox.
